scope: Targeted starting bibliography; not a systematic or exhaustive review.

evidence_levels.metadata: Bibliographic facts only; no detailed scientific assertion inferred.
evidence_levels.selected_full_text: Only listed portions read; not an exhaustive reading or independent reproduction.

references.title: NLOS identification and mitigation for localization based on UWB experimental data
references.venue: IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications
references.supports: Prior work specifically studies UWB NLOS identification and mitigation.
references.does_not_establish: No reproduction or detailed algorithm/performance claim.

references.title: Robust Extended Kalman filter for NLOS mitigation and sensor data fusion
references.venue: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Inertial Sensors and Systems (INERTIAL)
references.supports: Robust EKF for NLOS mitigation and sensor fusion predates this project.
references.does_not_establish: No claim of equivalence to, or improvement over, this algorithm.

references.title: UWB localization using adaptive covariance Kalman Filter based on sensor fusion
references.venue: 2017 IEEE 17th International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
references.supports: Adaptive-covariance UWB sensor fusion predates this project.
references.does_not_establish: No detailed formulation or quantitative comparison verified.

references.title: An Invariant Extended Kalman Filter for IMU-UWB Sensor Fusion
references.venue: 2024 33rd IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (ROMAN)
references.supports: Invariant IMU-UWB filtering is a relevant comparison candidate.
references.does_not_establish: Full-text method and experiments not reviewed.

references.title: Continuous-Time Ultra-Wideband-Inertial Fusion
references.sections_reviewed: Author preprint abstract and introduction; publication metadata
references.supports: UWB-inertial fusion includes continuous-time spline-based methods and asynchronous fusion.
references.does_not_establish: Reported performance is not independently reproduced; not a systematic comparison.

references.title: Indoor and Outdoor Seamless Positioning Method Using UWB Enhanced Multi-Sensor Tightly-Coupled Integration
references.sections_reviewed: Crossref bibliographic record only; proposal reference [24]
references.supports: Proposal [24] metadata matches a published tightly coupled UWB/multisensor article.

references.title: Indoor Localization System With NLOS Mitigation Based on Self-Training
references.sections_reviewed: Crossref bibliographic record only; proposal reference [25]
references.supports: Self-training NLOS mitigation is a relevant comparison candidate.
references.does_not_establish: Issue publication is July 2023; 2022 in DOI is not the issue year. Full-text not reviewed.

references.title: Ranging With Ultrawide Bandwidth Signals in Multipath Environments
references.supports: Canonical background on UWB ranging in multipath environments.
references.does_not_establish: No specific numerical accuracy or propagation guarantee verified.

references.title: UTIL: An ultra-wideband time-difference-of-arrival indoor localization dataset
references.venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research
references.sections_reviewed: Publisher-supplied abstract; author dataset website; author preprint Sections 3–5, Eq. (4), Table 3
references.supports: Real quadrotor dataset with TDOA, IMU, surveyed anchors, static/dynamic obstacles and motion-capture poses.
references.does_not_establish: Dataset files not downloaded or evaluated; redistribution license not confirmed.

references.title: Quaternion kinematics for the error-state Kalman filter
references.sections_reviewed: Author preprint Sections 5 and 6 (IMU error-state formulation, error injection, covariance reset); landing-page metadata
references.supports: Nominal quaternion and local attitude-error representation; IMU kinematics; covariance reset after injection.
references.does_not_establish: Does not establish UWB-specific performance or novelty.

references.title: Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation: Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) and GMAC
references.sections_reviewed: Official landing page; standard Sections 5.2 and 8; Appendices A and D
references.supports: Authenticated encryption, IV uniqueness, and explicit need for replay protection outside GCM.
references.does_not_establish: No guarantee against spoofed physical ranging, compromised sensors/keys, jamming, or denial of service. The landing page announces planned revision; cited document is 2007 final.

references.title: An Interface and Algorithms for Authenticated Encryption
references.supports: AEAD interface, distinct nonces per key, counter construction, reboot considerations and nonce-reuse consequences.
references.does_not_establish: The AEAD interface does not itself provide anti-replay or access-control services.
